hook.text: A director was offered a VP role but turned it down. Nobody was ready to replace her. She'd become a bottleneck.

buildup.text: Leaders who don't develop replacements trap themselves. You can't move up if nobody can fill your current role.

discovery.text: Identify and groom potential successors from day one. Teach them your role gradually by sharing context and decisions.

twist.text: Developing your replacement isn't threatening. It signals you're ready for the next level and your team is strong.

climax.text: Ask yourself: if I left tomorrow, would my team thrive? If not, start transferring knowledge and authority today.

punchline.text: Grow your replacement. It frees you to grow too.

quiz.question: Why is succession planning important for a leader's own career?
options: Companies require it as part of performance reviews
You can't advance if nobody is ready to fill your current role
It reduces the leader's workload immediately
